observations: Photos show open-air stacks of used car tires at a roadside tire stall/market.
Tires have spray-paint markings (letters/numbers like 'YES', 'MRS', 'NO 10') likely used by sellers to code size or batch, not legible as size or brand.
Sidewalls are caked with dust/dirt; no readable DOT code, size (e.g. 205/55R16), or manufacturer name in any photo.
Tread wear varies visibly across tires in the stacks - some look to have moderate tread, others appear more worn, but no close-up allows a reliable reading.
Background shows alloy rims hanging for sale, confirming this is a tire/rim market stall, not a private seller's own car tires.
No single tire is isolated or labelled as 'the item for sale' - the photos show general stock, not a specific unit with a clear price-relevant spec.

identity.kind: used car tire (sold from mixed stock)

claims.evidence: No country-of-origin marking, DOT code, or grade stamp is legible in any photo; 'first grade' and 'Belgium' are seller assertions only.

risks.risk: Tire size (rim diameter/width) unknown, which drives price far more than condition
risks.proof: Close-up photo of one sidewall showing the full size code, e.g. 205/55R16
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all, size is a precondition for any tire price

risks.risk: Actual tread depth and wear per tire, hidden by dirt and stacking
risks.proof: Close-up of tread face with a coin or gauge for scale on the specific tire being sold

risks.risk: Country of manufacture / 'Belgium' origin claim unverifiable
risks.proof: Clear photo of sidewall text showing 'Made in Belgium' or manufacturer name
risks.if_unproven: treated as unknown origin, not premium European stock

risks.risk: Age of rubber (dry rot risk) not visible
risks.proof: Close-up of DOT date code on sidewall

risks.risk: Sidewall damage (bulges, cracks, repairs) hidden by paint markings and dirt
risks.proof: Clean, well-lit photo of full sidewall circumference
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible sidewall damage

risks.risk: Unclear which specific tire(s) out of the stacked stock the buyer is actually being offered
risks.proof: Photo or video isolating the exact unit(s) for sale with a tag or marker
risks.if_unproven: cannot be matched to a specific price point

proof_requests: Close-up of the sidewall size code (e.g. 205/55R16) for the specific tire(s) on offer
Close-up of tread depth on the actual unit(s) being sold, with a coin or ruler for scale
Close-up of the DOT date code and any 'Made in ...' text on the sidewall
A photo or video clearly isolating which tire(s) in the stack are the ones for sale
response.reason: The photos show an undifferentiated stock of dirty, used tires with no visible size, brand, or origin markings, and it is unclear which specific tire(s) are being offered; size alone changes the price bracket entirely, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without it.
